business_problem: Store team members need fast, reliable answers to process and procedure questions, plus on-the-job coaching for new and seasonal workers, so they can handle operations efficiently and serve guests better.
solution_summary: Target built Store Companion with its in-house technology team as a generative AI chatbot for store employees. The application is delivered as an app on specially equipped handheld devices used in stores, where team members can ask natural-language questions about procedures such as signing up a guest for a Target Circle Card or restarting a cash register after a power outage. To ground the assistant, Target used real frequently asked questions and process documents from store teams across the U.S., then continued refining the tool with feedback from pilot locations and additional materials contributed by experienced team members. The chatbot returns instructions and resources in seconds, supports store operations management, and coaches new workers on the job. The release describes the serving channel and content inputs clearly, but does not name separate external model, storage, or orchestration products.
